actions: Verified primary Saha-Ramdas non-partitioned e-detector formulas, two-interval stopping lemma and late-change scope.
Re-derived Moen dynamic-grid consecutive spacing from its exact residue formula and proved a 3/5 coverage strengthening.
Constructed a closed-form pathwise-lower short/long pair certificate for the sub-Gaussian detector.
Combined one long geometric scale with O(log t) short scales to derive O(log t) update/storage and a 5/3 high-probability late-change factor.
Derived an ARL-valid deterministic cap to restore finite stopping without claiming first-order expected CADD.
Extended the pathwise-lower architecture conservatively to bounded means via the source KL lower bound/Pinsker.
exact_next_action: Prove an explicit finite-sample miss tail for cf-g1-r54 at d=c log(A)/I and test whether the ARL-valid timeout contributes o(log A) expected delay; otherwise pivot to the studentized unknown-variance Gaussian pair certificate with certified one-dimensional balancing.
